I could not complete the task. The TodoMVC demo requires pressing Enter to commit each todo, but the only input method available (input_text) fills the field without pressing Enter, and no key-press action exists in my toolset. Across ~16 attempts on 5 fresh tabs, 'Email supplier' and 'Review invoice' were typed into the "What needs to be done?" input but never committed — the list, checkboxes, and Active filter never appeared. The steps completed so far: typed 'Email supplier' then 'Review invoice' as requested, but they were never added, so marking 'Email supplier' complete, clicking Active, and verifying the filtered state were not possible. If you can add a 'press Enter / press_key' action to the toolset, I can finish this task.
